note: REPORTED numbers, not decisions (pred/01 §6). local_memory_bytes = low dword of pipestat Local Memory Size. full_* = m5_sass_full.py: the whole CS/FS code (all zstd frames, the longest clean prefix of Binary Size; full_instructions excludes the trailing NOP/BRA padding, full_instructions_raw includes it); s16_* = scripts/s16_sass.py (first zstd frame only; its PS window ends at the first unconditional EXIT). full_mem = memory opcodes with their width suffix; const_bank_split: cx[] = indexed constant bank (uniform-buffer descriptor load), c[] = fixed bank.
